To 22trillionAsecond you listen! Form is CRUCIAL for so many reasons. The first being that the proper muscles are taking on the load. The second being that smaller muscles do not become overloaded and an injury occurs. The third is because you don’t want to look like a woman with one tit bigger than the other. When you get your form down then you can change things up to stimulate muscle growth in other ways. You can explode up and then get an isometric workout by lowering yourself very slowly. After that you can do the motion in small increments. Like, two inches up & stop, then another 2-3, etc.. Or you can stay low and do a ton of 3 inch pushups and strengthen the small twitch fibers which will help you increase lifting heavier weights later. Imo it all comes down to checking your ego at the door because it’s not about the weight we lift or how many reps you can perform. As long as you are targeting the muscles correctly that you are trying to grow, gains will be made.
